claude_proposed_widenings.name: magic_item summoned-companion mechanics family
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item's deterministic core mechanic is an activated magic item that creates, commands, and later dismisses a companion, but MagicItemMechanics only admits passive, activation, triggered_reaction, or composite over those families. The existing summon/control payloads are spell-only (`spawned_creature` and `reanimated_creature`), so there is no honest magic-item record shape for this item.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: While gently swinging this censer, you can take a Magic action to summon an Air Elemental. The elemental appears in an unoccupied space as close to the censer as possible, understands your languages, obeys your commands, and takes its turn immediately after you on your Initiative count. The elemental disappears after 1 hour, when it dies, or when you dismiss it as a Bonus Action. The censer can't be used this way again until the next dawn.
